source: OCR's subject grade boundaries for A Level Law (H418), out of 240: three 80-mark papers added together with no weighting. Figures as compiled by tutor2u from OCR's boundary documents and not yet checked by us against OCR's own PDFs. OCR sets a separate boundary for each option (Papers 1, 2 and 3, or Papers 1, 2 and 4); in some years the two differ by one to three marks, so treat these as a guide.
